svg.title: \begin{aligned} &\approx \beta_0 + \beta_1 \times \texttt{income}_i + \begin{cases} \beta_2 & \text{if } i\text{th person is a student} \end{cases} \\ &= \beta_1 \times \texttt{income}_i + \begin{cases} \beta_0 + \beta_2 & \text{if } i\text{th person is a student} \end{cases} \end{aligned}
